tagline: Alert anyone with a few clicks away.

story.inspiration: We were inspired by the recent Winter Storm that occurred in Texas. We were concerned about people's inability to reach to loved ones or emergency services during power outages.
story.whatItDoes: Using a low powered emergency communication device , we can send and receive data from the web app.
story.howWeBuiltIt: We built our project using an ESP-8266 with on board Arduino code that talks to a web app hosted on firebase.

apiConnection.title: API Connection to Web Server
apiConnection.description: We faced a major challenge in establishing API connection to the web server.

hardwareAssembly.title: Lack of Soldering Iron
hardwareAssembly.description: Also, we did not have a soldering iron which hindered ability to connect the electrical components in a professional manner.

integrationAndMotive.title: Low Cost Integration and Motive
integrationAndMotive.description: We are proud of our low cost hardware and software integration. Also, we are proud of our motive, for we saw how many people struggled with lack of electricity in Texas. Our team also worked with many technologies with which group members were not familiar with.

story.whatWeLearned: We learned how to make http request from a micro controller. We also learned how to control APIs using a hardware.
story.whatIsNext: We want to integrate weather, google calendar and capital bank APIs in our web app.

prizes: Winner MLH Best Hardware Hack Sponsored by Digi-Key

team.name: mariam joseph
team.contribution: With the help of my team members, I learned how to create our Smart Sign website using html and css. Through this project, I was also able to gain an exposure to Firebase application.
